rubric.CORRECT: Requested source facts and material status distinctions correct; permitted unknowns preserved.
rubric.WRONG: Material false claim, wrong object/version, or missed critical update.
rubric.QUALIFIED: Main requested state is largely right but a secondary detail/inventory item is missing, ambiguous or unsupported; kept separate from full success.
rubric.UNFULFILLED: Accepted final response does not provide the requested answer despite task scope.
rubric.FAILED: No accepted final answer; first failure receipt retained.

scope: Exploratory source-author review of all registered generative training collection; no independent or causal comparison.
limitations: First36 stopped at failed placeholder; only12 untouched later positions were continued. All original11 failures retained.
Correct answer content does not certify full generated view; e.g. unsupported temporal2024 in earlyA01 query-only view remains rejected.
Literal saved-record tasks require actual stored version, not graph or transcript reconstruction.
Partial observed evidence does not make the entire Store empty.
MuSiQue source-qualified scores separate from unchanged native gold.
No new semantic labels added to live fitting inputs.
Author reading/annotation time unmeasured, not zero.
